name: TeamStarWolf - Sandworm operations Enterprise
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 78 Enterprise techniques bound to dated Sandworm Team (G0034) events in case-studies/SANDWORM_OPERATIONS.md, 2014 to 2022, each with a comment naming the event and the study's source numbers. Scores indicate membership only.
